programs.title: 2027 Career Development Award
programs.indirect_note: Published amounts already include the stated 10% institutional indirect costs.
programs.description: Mentored early-career cardiovascular and cerebrovascular research and training.
eligibility: Eligible U.S. nonprofit host; no state-specific restriction is listed.

A qualifying doctorate is required at application. Faculty/staff appointment at assistant-professor level or equivalent or below must be secured by activation, within six years of the first qualifying appointment; documented training or career-interruption exceptions apply.
Prior NIH R01 or K99/R00 recipients and current or former AHA Career Development/Scientist Development awardees are excluded. Other NIH K support requires nonoverlapping budgets.
At least 10% effort, two mentors including one outside the department/division/institution, and a career-development plan are required.
AHA Professional Membership, institutional sign-off and one application per deadline are required; the same project is limited to three submissions.
Allowed status at submission and through funding: U.S. citizen, permanent resident, qualifying I-485 pending resident, E-3, G-4, H-1B, O-1, TN or DACA; review the source documentation conditions.

programs.title: 2027 Innovative Project Award
programs.indirect_note: Published amounts already include the stated 10% indirect costs.
programs.description: Novel cardiovascular and cerebrovascular research ideas without preliminary results.
eligibility: Eligible U.S. nonprofit host; no state-specific restriction is listed.
A research or clinical doctorate and employment beyond fellowship/training are required; no additional career-rank, discipline or seniority limit is listed.
AHA Professional Membership and institutional authorization are required.
Applicants must complete assigned peer reviews for their own pre-proposal to advance; reviewer registration is required.
The idea must not previously have been submitted to AHA. Preliminary data are prohibited; comply with blinded pre-proposal and format requirements.
The initial pre-proposal is mandatory; the later full-application stage requires invitation.

At submission and through funding, retain a permitted status: U.S. citizenship, permanent residence, qualifying I-485 pending residence, E-3, G-4, H-1B, O-1, TN or DACA. Fellowship-only F-1/J-1 clauses do not waive the exclusion of fellows.
